sourceContracts.title: 公开分享阅读：普通笔记
permissionRules: No owner session required; 43-character token must be active/unexpired and note exists.
No password field/gate exists. Public page has noindex,nofollow. Shared content follows latest saved original.
CanEdit requires edit permission and supported Markdown; large/long-line or graph-document sources remain read-only.

A resolved embedded whiteboard uses the current share board endpoint and board.capabilities.canDownloadSource; only that resolved capability governs source-tab availability. The server includes source content/path only when allowDiagramSource and the underlying resource permit it.

DiagramPreview canEdit requires !readOnly && !shareToken && resourceEdit; canGenerate additionally requires editable=true. A guest/shareToken can never edit design, edit diagram source, convert to whiteboard or generate portable preview, even when original-source download is allowed.
importantStates: images/attachments through capability; diagram previews read-only

Public graph-document and Excalidraw-reference read projections may be ordinary PNG preview images with public explanatory body and no source tab/download control; source-allowed setting does not turn such an image into an editor.

When an embedded whiteboard is actually resolved into DiagramPreview (including public rich editing), canDownloadSource=false hides the source tab and clears a previously visible source panel; preview/expand/retry remain the appropriate read controls.

For a resolved board whose capability explicitly permits source, source tab reveals only returned sourceText and its local Download source action. The same card still has no edit/convert/generate controls for a shareToken.

responsive.supported: Source-defined responsive layout; not runtime-verified in this read-only inventory
responsive.behavior: <=720px article becomes single column and desktop TOC changes to native mobile details; code/tables scroll within content (ShareReader.vue:490). Runtime unverified.

sourceContracts.designReason: A concrete page with its own content, action hierarchy and business state; include in the GPT Image 2 review queue before implementation.
notes: Public guest page must retain guest-only navigation; no owner workspace rails.
Actual shared component path is apps/web/components/DiagramPreview.vue; there is no PublicDiagramPreview.vue at this baseline.

Ordinary inline SVG/Mermaid code already present in shared Markdown retains inline rendering; this is distinct from permission to fetch private/native board source. Do not infer original-source access from a source-tab screenshot or from note edit permission alone.

Download is a local Blob of sourceText: for Excalidraw this is boardSource || provided scene || fence code. The component does not fetch an owner asset or an extra source.path to fill missing source.content; do not depict such a fetch as implemented.

postprocessing: Original built-in PNG copied byte-for-byte; no pixel edits.
